findings.evidence: Mathlib has `theorem martingale_condExp [CompleteSpace E] (f : Ω → E) (ℱ : Filtration ι m0) (μ : Measure Ω) [SigmaFiniteFiltration μ ℱ] : Martingale (fun i => μ[f | ℱ i]) ℱ μ` at `mathlib/Mathlib/Probability/Martingale/Basic.lean:141`; the PR proof at lines 81-85 rewrites to exactly that theorem.
findings.fix: Remove this public theorem and use `martingale_condExp f (revFiltration 𝔽 h_antitone h_le N) μ`, with `simpa [revCondExpFinite_apply, revFiltration_apply]` at call sites that use `revCondExpFinite`.
findings.issue: `martingale_revCondExpFinite` is a thin restatement of existing `MeasureTheory.martingale_condExp` for the particular filtration `revFiltration 𝔽 h_antitone h_le N`.

summary: The PR adds a public martingale theorem that is just Mathlib's existing conditional-expectation martingale theorem after the new definitions are unfolded.
